s: During fiscal 2025, the Company focused on asset preservation and the modernization of its business model, which included streamlining international operations and exploring the integration of blockchain and AI technologies within the regulated cannabis ecosystem. Our first business opportunity was, and continues to be, through our wholly-owned subsidiary, Sangre AT, LLC (“Sangre”), where we are focused on the development and application of cannabis-derived compounds for the treatment of human disease and animal ailments.
